title: A $k$-arc-connected orientation of a $2k$-edge-connected Eulerian graph
statement: Let $G$ be a finite graph on a nonempty vertex set that admits an Eulerian trail — a walk traversing every edge of $G$ exactly once — and let $k$ be a natural number with $2k \le \kappa'(G)$. Then $G$ has an orientation that is $k$-arc-connected.
hypotheses_covered: finite graph on a nonempty vertex set
G admits an Eulerian trail (a walk using each edge exactly once)
replaced:
\emph{Let \texttt{G} be a \texttt{2k}-edge-connected graph with an Euler trail.
Then \texttt{G} has a \texttt{k}-arc-connected orientation.}
